shots.detail_en: CH plants himself at the old hall's threshold at opening, eyes locked on the Lianhua Industrial cell high on the great board.
CH slaps a fist-thick stack of buy slips onto the counter and looks the clerk dead in the eye.
shots.sub: 从今天起，联华实业的每一根K线——都得先问过我。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: RED slides a folded tally sheet from under her ledger into CH's palm, eyes never leaving the fake account she is checking.
shots.sub: 今天的成交明细，只有柜台的账本看得全——拿好，别问。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: MANCANG rolls up his sleeves and plants himself at CH's shoulder like a bodyguard.
shots.sub: 全仓跟老大——名字早写好了，满仓！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH follows the board as the Lianhua Industrial cell flips green-to-red and climbs, the whole hall beginning to buzz about the unseen hand buying.
XIONG's eyes snap open in the VIP box and he turns his chair toward the hall floor for the first time in ten years.
shots.sub: 有意思——我一直以为，市场只有我这只手。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI pushes up his glasses as green data streams across the terminal, reading the anomaly like weather.
shots.sub: 异常买单聚类，置信度0.92；对手画像：单一自然人，非机构。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: CH climbs onto a chair and declares war to the entire hall, voice carrying over every counter.
shots.sub: 都听好了——联华实业，我长虹，公开建仓！
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG is swallowed by the erupting hall as Retail Investor A leads the charge back to the counters.
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: XIONG rises to the mezzanine rail, tea abandoned on the table, and studies CH's upturned face as if memorizing it for the first time.
shots.sub: 那就让他看清楚——市场这只手翻脸的时候，连自己都握不住。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH holds his ground as the Lianhua Industrial cell strobes red and green — a monstrous sell wall slamming down while his buys punch up through it.
RED leans to CH's ear with the ticker tape crawling through her fingers, reading the other side's breath in every print.
shots.sub: 对面抛了四千手——他在试你身家。接得住，他就是纸老虎。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: MANCANG slams his last stack of slips over the counter, shouting himself hoarse.
shots.sub: 接！我的仓位就是老大的墙——满仓的墙！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH reads the strobing board like an open book, light flickering in his eyes.
shots.sub: K线会说话——他每一笔抛单，都在给我递他的底牌。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH wipes his sweat as the closing bell settles in slow motion, Lianhua Industrial locked in red on the board.
XIONG leans over the dark mezzanine rail, tracking CH's small back all the way to the door.
shots.sub: 十年了……第一次有张脸，值得我看清。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI types two lines and a new folder materializes on his terminal, cursor blinking over its empty name field.
shots.sub: 建议：建立战役档案。目标：狙击联华实业者。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI names the folder 'New Campaign — Lianhua Industrial' with a single cold keystroke.
shots.sub: 档案建立——参数归位，开始观测。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI drags the old file marked 'Sample No.1' across the screen and drops it into the new campaign folder, the word 'merged' blinking green.
shots.sub: 样本一号，重新激活——这一次，他自己走进来了。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI's glasses catch the terminal's cold glow as the new folder settles beside a drawn red circle.
XIONGWEI's flat voice states 'observation begins' over a black screen as bold white characters bloom: 'Sample No.1 — merged into the new campaign.'
shots.speaker: 熊伟（画外）
shots.card: 样本一号·已并入新战役|下集《样本一号》
